title: Small Group Leader Guides
intro: Pick your group. Middle school and high school messages are sometimes different, so each has its own guide.

guides.title: Middle School Small Group Leader Guide
guides.thisWeekEmpty: No middle school guide posted for this week yet.

weeks.title: JW & Jesus
weeks.bigIdea: Just because you believe you know the Father doesn’t mean you understand the Son.

weeks.title: Hebrew Israelites & Jesus
weeks.bigIdea: Sometimes people want Jesus to be more like them than for them to become more like Jesus.

weeks.title: Design
weeks.bigIdea: You are designed with purpose and responsibility, given to you by God.

weeks.title: Purpose
weeks.bigIdea: Our purpose is to know and follow Jesus while sharing Him with others.

weeks.title: Direction
weeks.bigIdea: God created everything with a purpose; sin is using what He made in ways He did not design.

weeks.title: Responsibility
weeks.bigIdea: God has created us to take on responsibility, and in doing so, we find meaning and purpose.

weeks.title: Pastor's Choice
weeks.note: Open week. Scripture and big idea are finalized with Jake before Monday and aren't posted yet.

weeks.title: Redirection
weeks.scripture: Psalm 63:1-5; Romans 5:12; Romans 3:23; Luke 7:36-39, 44-47; Romans 2:4; Isaiah 26:3
weeks.bigIdea: Prayer and worship are part of the ongoing conversation we have with a personal and relational God. They are expressions of our dependence on and love for God.

weeks.title: Relationship
weeks.bigIdea: Jesus modeled the importance of prayer, continually seeking the Father’s will over his own, and giving us a pattern to follow.

weeks.title: Reflection
weeks.bigIdea: God created humans to know and worship him. We do this by reflecting his image to the world around us through our actions and treatment of others.

weeks.title: Rhythms
weeks.bigIdea: It is important to establish a daily rhythm of prayer and worship in our lives through God’s Word, Christian community, and continued surrender before God.

weeks.title: Anxiety
weeks.bigIdea: God cares about our anxiety; prayer, gratitude, and focusing on God and others help put anxiety in its place.

weeks.title: Depression
weeks.bigIdea: We can trust God while experiencing depression and ask Him to turn our despair into hope.

weeks.title: Attachment
weeks.bigIdea: In Christ, we can find the secure love and trust we need to know who we are and build healthy relationships.

weeks.title: Facing the Opps
weeks.bigIdea: We can overcome opposition through faith in God and His promises.

weeks.title: The Hype vs. The Hope
weeks.bigIdea: We often get caught up in the “hype” of Christmas, but the true meaning offers lasting hope.

weeks.title: The Perfect Gift
weeks.bigIdea: The ultimate gift is Jesus, who came to give, not to receive.

items.title: Junior high · 6th–8th
items.body: Use concrete language, shorter stories, fewer abstractions, clear definitions, and explicit application. Assume less background knowledge.
items.source: Fall 2026 Student Ministry Preaching Calendar · Guest Teacher Guide

items.title: 25 minutes around the tables
items.body: On Sunday mornings the devotionals run 25 minutes around the tables and follow the same structure as the 5–7 minute message. They're hosted on Canva and usually prepared for the month ahead.

items.title: High school · 9th–12th
items.body: Students can handle greater nuance, tension, theological complexity, and unresolved questions. Be clear without oversimplifying.
items.source: Fall 2026 Student Ministry Preaching Calendar · Guest Teacher Guide

items.title: Topic sensitivity
bullets: Green: standard teaching. Normal pastoral wisdom.
Yellow: extra care. Leaders are made aware of the topic before service.
Red: parents are contacted before the message, with closer content review.
items.source: Fall 2026 Student Ministry Preaching Calendar · Guest Teacher Guide

items.title: Mixed spiritual maturity
items.body: Some students know Scripture well; others are exploring faith for the first time. Explain church vocabulary rather than assuming it.
items.source: Fall 2026 Student Ministry Preaching Calendar · Guest Teacher Guide

items.title: What a good guide includes
bullets: The Scripture reference, the purpose, and one clear big idea.
Enough context for the group to locate the passage.
A response and a prayer, kept in proportion to the time you have.

items.title: Asking questions
bullets: Move from observation, to meaning, to application.
Go further than “What did you think?”
Let application come from what the text says, not from a list of tips.

items.title: Leader-practice focus
items.body: Modeling engagement and praying with students.

items.title: Safety and serious disclosures
bullets: Don't counsel a student alone in a closed room. Keep conversations observable.
Don't promise secrecy. If a student discloses abuse, self-harm, danger, or another serious concern, involve Jake or the designated ministry leader right away.
items.source: Fall 2026 Student Ministry Preaching Calendar · Guest Teacher Guide
